scripts.text:
[Boya]
You are not in my group are you?
I don't have anything to say to outsiders.
If you want something register with my group.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你不是我小隊的成員吧？
我沒什麼可對外人說的。
想要什麼就先加入我們小隊。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
What's up?
If you have any normal missions use the bulletin board.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
有什麼事？
普通任務請看公告板。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Hey, I already talked all about the training areas.
I will explain again please concentrate.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
喂，訓練地點的事我都講過了。
我再說一遍，你仔細聽。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Oh you've come back.
Good job.
Now you are adapting.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
哦，你回來了。
做得不錯。
看來你已經適應這裡了。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
The training name was 'Conquer the Culvert!.
Did you explore the culvert fully?
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
訓練專案叫“征服下水道”！
你把下水道徹底探索過了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Oh you're back.
Good job.
Now you are adapting.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
哦，你回來了。
做得不錯。
看來你已經適應這裡了。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Um, did you like the supplies?
I like the red hat.
The red ribbon is really cute.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
嗯，補給品還喜歡嗎？
我喜歡那頂紅帽子。
紅色緞帶也很可愛。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
You finished the second step of training.
Now do you understand how this world is organized?
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你完成了第二階段訓練。
現在明白這個世界的格局了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
The training area is southwest of Morocc.
Enter the Saint Darmain Fortress to reach it directly.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
訓練場在夢羅克西南方。
進入聖達梅因要塞就能直接抵達。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
We serve trainees with equipment and armor after passing the second step of training.
Go to the storage and meet the person in charge there.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
通過第二階段訓練後，我們會給學員提供裝備和護甲。
去倉庫找負責人領取吧。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Hey long time no see.
So what's up?
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
好久不見。
最近怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Umm. Orc village has a Kafra Employee there so you can use the Kafra services.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
嗯，獸人村裡有卡普拉職員，可以使用卡普拉服務。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Cool! You passed the third step of training.
I will certify that you completed the training.
The person in charge of equipment storage will supply you with some equipment.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
太棒了！你通過了第三階段訓練。
我會為你完成訓練作記錄。
去裝備倉庫找負責人領取裝備吧。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Umm. Orc village has a Kafra Employee there so you can use the Kafra services there.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Boya]
First take a ship toward to Bayalan from Izlude!
There is an underground cave. Go in and get to the bottom floor where you will find a historic underwater city..
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
先從依斯魯得島乘船去巴亞蘭！
那裡有個地下洞窟。進去後一直往下走，最底層就是一座古老的海底城市。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
[Boya]
If you finish all of the steps go and get your supplies.
We offer equipment to those who complete the training.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
完成所有階段後，就去領取補給品吧。
完成訓練的人都能領取裝備。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
My boss created all the courses for the training.
After he manufactured the uniform and supplies he changed his mind and said that he can't give them for free.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
訓練課程都是我老闆設計的。
他把制服和補給品都準備好了，卻突然改口說不能免費發給大家。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
What do you want?
I doubt that you need more training.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你想做什麼？
我看你應該不需要再訓練了。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
What are you doing?
Get the equipment from the storage manager.
Our uniform is pretty awesome haha.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你在做什麼？
去倉庫找負責人領裝備。
我們的制服可帥了，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
The training area is at the north cave of Payon.
A staff member is already dispatched there.
Find him and follow his directions.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
訓練場在斐揚北邊的洞窟裡。
我們已經派了一名工作人員過去。
去找他，聽從他的安排。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
To register with the Eden Group ask Laime Evenor next to me.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
要加入伊甸園，請找我旁邊的萊梅·伊維諾爾。

scripts.text: What is your responsibility?
scripts.translation: 你的職責是什麼？

scripts.text: Don't you have equipment?
scripts.translation: 你沒有裝備嗎？

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 算了。

[Boya]
I give training missions to members.
That's why they participate in it.
If they don't want to get in trouble, it's essential.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
我會給隊員安排訓練任務。
所以他們才會參加訓練。
想不惹麻煩，這些訓練可少不了。

Huh?
You are so honest!
Gosh. You wanted to know something about equipment?

咦？
你還挺坦率的嘛！
天哪，你是想問裝備的事吧？

scripts.text:

scripts.translation: [博雅]

The members that prove themselves will even get a reward.
scripts.translation:

表現出色的人還能得到獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
We gave them special equipmant that we have made.
These gifts are for people who are really doing their best.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
我們給他們準備了特製裝備。
這些是獎勵給努力訓練的隊員的。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
If you are curious, you can join.
The training battle course is not very difficult.
There's nothing to worry about.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
感興趣的話就加入吧。
戰鬥訓練沒那麼難，
不用擔心。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
If you want to join, don't hesitate.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
想加入的話就別猶豫。

scripts.translation: 參加訓練

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.translation: [博雅]

It's all your decision.

一切由你決定。

I have a uniform set which is free for our group members.
But, I can't give it for free.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
我這裡有套制服，隊員可以免費領取。
不過嘛，我可不會隨便白送。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
We give it to great participants who do their best in the training.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
只有在訓練中表現出色、全力以赴的人才配得上它。

scripts.text:
-Boya eyes you from top to bottom.
Hmm... he seems to think something is wrong.-
scripts.translation:
- 博雅從頭到腳打量了你一番。
嗯……他似乎覺得哪裡不太對。 -

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Due to emotion.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
因為心情。

scripts.text: What?!
scripts.translation: 什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Boya]
So, will you join the training or not?
I look a little bit funny, actually I am really busy I was called shining Rune Knight.
Make a decision, hurry.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
所以，你到底參不參加訓練？
我看起來是有點滑稽，不過我可是很忙的，人稱“閃耀的盧恩騎士”。
快點決定。

scripts.text: Participate in the training.
scripts.translation: 參加訓練

scripts.text: Refuse!!

scripts.translation: [博雅]

你也太沒禮貌了！

別來煩我。

scripts.text:

It hurts too much-
scripts.translation:
- 一陣急促的敲擊聲後，這位閃耀的盧恩騎士消失了。
疼死了！ -

scripts.text:
[Boya]
An oasis souteast of Morocc.
There is a big dog in the center.
The detailed story is written in the log, see?
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
夢羅克東南方有片綠洲。
中央有一隻大狗。
詳細情況我寫進日誌裡了，看到了吧？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Completed step 1.
Congratulations.
We will give you a uniform and some equipment.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
第一階段完成。
恭喜！
我們會給你制服和一些裝備。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Can you see a large blue gate next to the board?
Go inside then keep walking until the end of the right passage. There is an equipment storage there.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
看到公告板旁邊那扇藍色大門了嗎？
進去後沿著右側通道一直走到盡頭，那裡就是裝備倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Inform the manager that I sent you. He will give you some stuff.
Go go go!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
告訴負責人是我派你來的，他會給你裝備。
快去快去！

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Come back when you've completed all the courses from the local trainer.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
等你完成當地教官安排的所有課程，再回來找我。

快去快去！

scripts.text:
[Boya]
And you seem to.
Able to take upper class, now.
What about it, do you want?
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
而且你似乎已經能參加更高階的訓練了。
怎麼樣，想試試嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
The battle training is organized into steps.
When you able to join next step come back again after leveling more.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
戰鬥訓練分為幾個階段。
達到下一階段的要求後，再提升些等級就回來找我。

scripts.text: No, way.
scripts.translation: 不，才不要。

scripts.text: Absolutely, I will.
scripts.translation: 當然要參加。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Really?
Actually I don't care but the uniform will be changed as upper class.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
真的？
其實我無所謂，不過制服會換成高階款式。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Cool.
Let me choose a proper place for you.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
好。
我來給你挑個合適的訓練地點。

scripts.text: [Boya]
scripts.translation: [博雅]

scripts.translation: [博雅]

The next training step is available for those over Level 26.
When you reach that level, come by again. get it?
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
下一階段訓練需要達到26級。
升到那個等級後再來找我，明白了嗎？

scripts.text:

I will certify that you completed the training.
The person in charge of equipment storage will supply you with what you need.
scripts.translation:

去裝備倉庫找負責人領取所需裝備吧。

scripts.text:

Choose an equipment that fits your particular set of skills.
scripts.translation:

選一套適合你職業和技能的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
There's someone there named... Uh... he is waiting for you to follow his direction.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
那裡有位工作人員……呃……他會等著給你指引。

scripts.translation:

穿過任務公告板旁邊的藍色大門，再沿右側走廊走到盡頭，就能找到倉庫。

Hmm... really?

嗯……真的？
我看看……哪個階段比較適合你……

scripts.text:

Did you come to see me?
Just that? Without anything?
At could have least brought some chocolate...
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
你是來看我的嗎？
就這樣？兩手空空？
至少帶點巧克力來嘛……

scripts.translation: [博雅]

Concentrate to become higher level then come back.

抱歉，不過參加這項訓練至少需要40級。
先努力升級，達到要求再回來吧。

Oh, I don't eat snacks with cinnamon...

香蕉卷、條紋吸管……什麼都行。
不過我不吃肉桂味的零食……

If you have any questions, ask the person in charge of the arsenal.
scripts.translation:

我們也可能會提供其他物品。
有問題就去問軍械庫的負責人。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

軍械庫在藍色大門後，沿著右側通道走到盡頭就是。

People who show their effort for my team and the world can get some supplies.
That's why these courses were made.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
為小隊和世界付出努力的人，都能獲得補給。
這就是開設這些課程的目的。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Basically we are supposed to offer these supplies for beginners
but if experts want to participate this training, we accept them.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
這些補給主要是為新手準備的，
不過老手想參加訓練，我們也歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Although the uniform and equipment might be useless.
participating in this training means they want to become a member of our group.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
對，就是這樣。
所以當初挑帽子樣式時，我們可費了不少心思。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Yes that's all.
That's why when we decided a hat design it was really difficult.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
使用這些裝備時，記住它們的用意。
當然，你要賣掉或轉手，我們也不管。

scripts.text:

Remember this when you use the equipment.
But if you decide to sell or trade them off, it is none of our concern.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
像你這樣的戰鬥高手，我已經沒什麼可教的了。

[Boya]

scripts.translation:

像你這樣的戰鬥高手，我已經沒什麼可教的了。

scripts.text:

Let me see...
scripts.translation:

嗯，你還得再升幾級！
至少要達到12級！
抱歉，這是規定。

scripts.text:

You need to be at least level 12!
I'm sorry but those are the rules.
scripts.translation:

第一階段是A課程。
課程名叫“征服沙漠！”。
這項任務最適合你當前的等級。

scripts.text:

It's the most proper mission for your level.

好。
我來給你挑個合適的訓練地點。

Cool.
Let me choose a proper place for you.

It's the most proper mission for your level.
scripts.translation:

斐揚北邊有個小小的弓箭手村。
村子西邊的山丘上有座洞窟。

There is a small archer village north of Payon.
There is a cave on the western hill of the archer village.
scripts.translation:

我們已經派人在洞窟前等你了。
他叫……呃……
……

scripts.text:
[Boya]
We have dispatched someone in front of the cave.
His name is... um...
...

總之，他是我們的人，認識我。

有問題就問他。

Anyway he is one of us so he will know me.

那地方離這裡不遠，快去快回。

scripts.translation:

總之……

去吧，願芙蕾雅保佑你～！

scripts.text:

It's the most proper mission for your level.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
從夢羅克城往西南方走。
那裡有個地洞，通往名為蟻穴的洞窟。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Travel just southwest of Morocc City.
There you will find a hole in the ground to a cave called Anthell.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
裡面有好多螞蟻，懂嗎？
洞裡還覆滿沙子，小心點，聽見沒有？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
There are lots of ants in there. kk?
It is also covered in sand so be careful in there ok.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
裡面有好多螞蟻呢，嘿嘿？
裡面還到處都是沙子，進去時小心點，知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Boya]
That's why it's called ant hell.
One of our members will be waiting there.
His name is... K? M? Hmm? Anyway I can't remember.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
所以那地方才叫蟻穴。
我們有位隊員會在那裡等你。
他名字好像是……K？M？嗯？總之，我想不起來了。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
He is one of us so he will know me.
He will give you a mission.
If you have any questions ask him.

That place is not far from here so, come back quickly.

scripts.translation:

總之……
那地方離這裡不遠，快去快回。
去吧，願芙蕾雅保佑你～！！

scripts.text:
You are on the third step of course A.
This course is called 'Conquer Orc village!'.
Let me see...
scripts.translation:
你正在參加A課程的第三階段。
課程名叫“征服獸人村！”。
我看看……

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Go through the gate of Prontera and keep walking to the west. Orc Village is in that direction.
Or you can go out through the western gate of Geffen and keep heading southeast..
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
穿過普隆德拉城門一直往西走，就能到獸人村。
也可以從吉芬西門出城，再一路往東南走……

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Umm. Orc village has a Kafra Employee dispatched there so you could use the Kafra services..
It's up to you.
scripts.translation:

嗯，獸人村有卡普拉職員駐守，可以在那裡使用卡普拉服務……
怎麼走由你決定。

scripts.text:

One of our dispatched members is waiting in the building near the Kafra Employee.
scripts.translation:

我們派去的隊員在卡普拉職員附近的建築裡等你。

scripts.text:

If you have any questions ask her.

她會告訴你在那裡要做什麼。
有問題就問她。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Ok, may Freya bless you!
scripts.translation:

好，願芙蕾雅保佑你！

It's the most proper mission for your level.
scripts.translation:

課程名叫“征服獸人地下洞窟！”。
這項任務最適合你當前的等級。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
You are on the last step.
This course is called 'Conquer the Ocean City!'.
I don't know if it is the proper course or not, but anyway it's the last course of our training.
scripts.translation:
你正在參加最後一個階段。
課程名叫“征服海之都！”。
我也不確定這是不是最合適的任務，不過這確實是訓練的最後一課。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
First take a ship to Byalan Island from Izlude!
There is an underground cave. Go in and get to the bottom floor where you will find a historic underwater city..
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
先從依斯魯得島乘船前往巴亞蘭島！
那裡有個地下洞窟。進去後一直走到最底層，就能找到古老的海底城市。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Although it's underwater, you can breath so don't worry.
There is a dispatched trainee around the entrance of the Ocean City.
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
雖然在水下也能呼吸，放心吧。
海之都入口附近有一位我們派來的學員。

scripts.text:
[Boya]
Tell him that I sent you and follow his directions.
Ok, may Freya bless you!
scripts.translation:
[博雅]
告訴他是我派你來的，然後聽從他的安排。
去吧，願芙蕾雅保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
kkkkuuuuahhh.
rrrrrruuuuhh.
bowwow..
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
嗷嗚嗚……
嗚嚕嚕……
汪汪……

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
What's up?
You are!
A member of the Eden Group.
Have you come to give me a meal? I don't like drinks.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
怎麼了？
哦，是你啊！
伊甸園的成員。
是來給我送飯的嗎？我不喜歡喝的東西。

scripts.text: Boya is really perfect.
scripts.translation: 博雅簡直完美。

scripts.text: Boya is really great.
scripts.translation: 博雅真的很棒。

scripts.text: Boya is really soft.
scripts.translation: 博雅非常溫柔。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Uhh...
What are you saying.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
呃……
你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Ahh... um...
Gosh, did you come here to participate in the training?
If Boya sent you then you know that it's battle training.
Bow wow...
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
啊……嗯……
天哪，你是來參加訓練的嗎？
既然是博雅派你來的，應該知道這是戰鬥訓練。
汪……

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
If so, should I start securing this oasis more clearly?
Can you see a Condor flying?
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
既然如此，我是不是該把這片綠洲守得更嚴密些？
你看到天上飛的禿鷹了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Can you scare them away for me?
So people can use this oasis safer and more comfortably.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
能幫我把它們趕走嗎？
這樣大家就能更安全、更安心地使用綠洲了。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
We should hunt at least 10 Condors, ok?
I will sleep for a while.
Krrrr woo bow...
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
至少獵殺10只禿鷹，好嗎？
我先睡一會兒。
呼嚕……汪……

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Are you ok?
Haven't you seen a talking dog before?
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你還好嗎？
以前沒見過會說話的狗嗎？
你在說什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Woooohh...
Great!
I can feel my youth from you.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
嗷嗚……
太棒了！
我從你身上感受到了青春活力。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Nevermind.
Let's find the next target kk!
Ok. Let's drive the Desert Wolves out of here.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
算了。
找下一個目標吧，汪！
好，把沙漠之狼趕出去。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
If they grow up they will become dangerous.
......
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
它們長大後會變得很危險。
……

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Why, why are you looking at me like that?
They are wolves and I am a nice dog.
But I haven't always been a dog my entire life.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你為什麼一直這樣看著我？
它們是狼，我可是條好狗。
不過，我也不是一輩子都是狗。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
I will show you that don't have to pity me at all.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
我會證明你根本不用同情我。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
They pee wherever and have no shame.
Just waving their tails when they grow up and biting people without any care!
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
它們到處撒尿，還一點羞恥心都沒有。
長大後只會搖著尾巴，逮誰咬誰！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
You must hunt at least 10!
Exactly 10!
Go go go!
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
至少要獵殺10只！
正好10只！
快去快去！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
First lets follow the bald and noisy bird.
Yes Condors.
Kill 10 Condors. It seems to easy, right?
Oh, if you are tired I will help you.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
先去對付那些禿頭又吵鬧的鳥。
沒錯，就是禿鷹。
獵殺10只禿鷹。聽起來很簡單吧？
累了的話，我會幫你。

scripts.text: -When the dog barked, your HP and SP recovered.-
scripts.translation: - 狗叫了幾聲，你的HP和SP恢復了。 -

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
You are so perfect.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你真是太完美了。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Or not. Hehe, anyway thanks for your help.
The oasis has almost been secured now.
Ok, it's the last step!
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
才怪。嘿嘿，不過還是謝謝你幫忙。
綠洲差不多安全了。
好，最後一步！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
There's an annoying monster that hides in the sand and poisons people out of nowhere.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
有種討厭的魔物藏在沙子裡，冷不防就會放毒。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
All beautiful things have some poison inside but these actually kill.
Kill Scorpions which are called the poison of the desert!
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
美麗的東西多少都帶點毒，可這些傢伙是真的會要命。
去消滅被稱為“沙漠之毒”的蠍子吧！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
It's the last step so let's make it simple
Just hunt 5!
Bow wow!
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
這是最後一步，簡單點吧。
只要獵殺5只！
汪！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
I don't want you to show any pity.
I am dog with a golden heart.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
不用同情我。
我可是條有顆金子般心腸的狗。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
After hunting the 10 Desert Wolves come back again.
Oh, if you are tired I will help you.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
獵殺10只沙漠之狼後再回來。
累了的話，我會幫你。

scripts.text: -When the dog barked, your HP and SP recovered.-
scripts.translation: - 狗叫了幾聲，你的HP和SP恢復了。 -

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Um. Excellent.
You are awesome!
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
嗯，幹得漂亮。
你真厲害！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Thanks to your effort the oasis is secure.
Don't look around!
If I say it's secure!
Uhuhuhuh aaaang!
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
多虧了你，綠洲安全了。
別東張西望！
我說安全了就是安全了！
嗚嗚嗚，嗷嗚！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Here here here.
If I dig more and more, I can find Scorpions but
this oasis will be safer for sure.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
就在這裡，就在這裡。
只要繼續挖，就能挖出蠍子來，
不過這片綠洲肯定會更安全。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
You can be proud and confident by yourself and do your best.
You've helped a lot to make my rest comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你儘管為自己驕傲，自信地繼續努力吧。
你幫了大忙，讓我能舒舒服服地休息。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
You've helped to conquer the desert,
and passed the beginner training steps so I will stamp my feet.
krrrrreuung. hup.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你幫忙征服了沙漠，
也完成了新手訓練階段，我要跺腳慶祝一下。
咔嚕嚕嚕，嘿！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters and show it to the flashy Rune Knight.
Let me say again that you are great!
Hooooohooo~
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
回伊甸園總部，把這個給那位閃亮的盧恩騎士看看。
我再說一遍，你真棒！
嗷嗚～

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Let's hunt only 5 Scorpions.
So we can make peace in this oasis.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
只要獵殺5只蠍子就行。
這樣綠洲就能恢復平靜了。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
When I take a nap they won't chew my tail any more.
Due to his mistake my feet won't be hurt at all.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
我打盹時，它們就不會再咬我的尾巴了。
多虧那傢伙搞錯了，我的腳才沒受傷。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
You can fight.
I can rest more comfortably.
Other people are going to be safer too.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你負責戰鬥，
我就能更安心地休息。
其他人也會更安全。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Everyone will think fondly of the Eden Group.
Oh, if you are tired I will help you.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
大家都會對伊甸園留下好印象。
累了的話，我會幫你。

scripts.text: -When the dog barked, your HP and SP recovered.-
scripts.translation: - 狗叫了幾聲，你的HP和SP恢復了。 -

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
kkkkkaaaaauuuunnng.
oopssss kup.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
嗷嗚嗚……
哎呀，撲通！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Why are you still here?
You are done here.
Hooooo bow wow.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你怎麼還在這兒？
這裡的事已經辦完了。
嗷嗚，汪！

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Hey man~ What's going on?
What about the Rune Knight?
Krrrrr...
Hyuk huk...
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
嘿，夥計～怎麼回事？
那位盧恩騎士怎麼樣了？
咔嚕嚕……
呼……哈……

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
The Eden Group is cool.
They're a really good group.
They accepted a wandering talking dog.
Take care and good luck.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
伊甸園真不錯。
他們真是個好團體。
竟然收留了我這隻流浪的會說話的狗。
保重，祝你好運。

scripts.text:
Hey look.
I'm a talking dog.
Not a wolf.
I wasn't a dog originally...
scripts.translation:
嘿，看好了。
我是一隻會說話的狗。
不是狼。
我原本也不是狗……

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Anyway are you a Eden Group member?
Oh good to see you.
I am also a member of Eden Group.
Take care and good luck.
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
對了，你是伊甸園的成員嗎？
太好了，見到你真高興。
我也是伊甸園的一員。
保重，祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Talking Dog]
Why are you looking at me like that?
......
scripts.translation:
[會說話的狗]
你幹嗎這樣看著我？
……

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Meow...
Who are you meow?
Why are you here meow?
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
喵……
你是誰，喵？
為什麼在這裡，喵？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Come on meow...
I may be standing here and talking to you like this meow but I am a still a cat meow...
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
拜託了，喵……
雖然我就站在這裡跟你說話，喵，但我還是一隻貓，喵……

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Dear human you are
a member of my group?
Re... really...!
Dear Boya's help is like a giant and...
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
親愛的人類，你也是
我們小隊的成員嗎？
真……真的嗎……！
親愛的博雅說，他的幫助就像一條巨大又……

scripts.text: Beautiful Saury
scripts.translation: 美麗的秋刀魚

scripts.text: Fresh Mackerel
scripts.translation: 新鮮的鯖魚

scripts.text: Beautiful Tuna
scripts.translation: 美麗的金槍魚

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Big and beautiful Saury...
I am shy.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
又大又漂亮的秋刀魚……
我有點害羞。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
I want to eat mackerel.
Where are the big and fresh mackerel meow?
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
我想吃鯖魚。
又大又新鮮的鯖魚在哪裡，喵？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Do you know the big and beautiful tuna?
Dear Boya sent you here for sure.
How do I explain this...?
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
你知道那條又大又美麗的金槍魚嗎？
肯定是親愛的博雅派你來的。
這個該怎麼說呢……？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Did something pass under my feet just now meow?
Do you want to kill a cat.
The environment here is terrible.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
剛才有什麼東西從我腳邊跑過去了嗎，喵？
你想殺貓嗎？
這裡的環境真糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Anyway I'm doing what I was assigned to do.
So hi, hello and welcome.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
總之，我正在完成分配給我的工作。
你好，歡迎來到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Did you come here to have a battle?
Hunt those Thief Bugs, hurry up!
Hunt at least 10!
Meooow!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
你是來參加戰鬥訓練的嗎？
快去獵殺盜蟲！
至少獵殺10只！
喵嗚！

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
I really don't like those nasty crawlers...
Meow~!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
我最討厭那些噁心的爬蟲了……
喵～！

scripts.text:
^4d4dffThe cat was suprised by
a thief bug and froze in
place. Hunt those
Thief Bugs around here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff那隻貓被盜蟲嚇得僵在原地。
去獵殺附近的盜蟲吧。^000000

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now do you understand the dirty and humid underground sewers?
Eeeh look what's next meow.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
現在知道地下下水道有多髒、多潮溼了吧？
哎呀，看看接下來要做什麼，喵。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
It's a symbol of dirt next to those Thief Bugs.
Hunt some Tarou to make the sewers cleaner.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
那些盜蟲旁邊還有個髒東西。
去獵殺幾隻白鼠，讓下水道乾淨些吧。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
For our members joining this mission.
Hunt 10 Tarou.
Easy, ain't it?
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
既然加入了這項訓練，
就去獵殺10只白鼠。
很簡單吧？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Why didn't I ask you at once? kkk..??
Umm........
Because it's just a training mission.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
我怎麼沒早點問你呢？呵呵……？
嗯……
因為這只是訓練任務嘛。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Training missions are hard and anoying.
So go hurry and hunt 10 Tarou.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
訓練任務又難又煩。
所以快去獵殺10只白鼠吧。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Clean the sewers. Now the first step is hunting Thief Bugs.
Isn't that simple, meow?
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
來清理下水道吧。第一步是獵殺盜蟲。
很簡單吧，喵？

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Take care to check your map so you don't get lost.
It's a service meeow.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
記得檢視地圖，免得迷路。
這是貼心服務，喵。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Great job~!
How'd you get rid of those dirty bugs and Tarou. You are brave.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
幹得漂亮～！
你是怎麼清除那些髒兮兮的盜蟲和白鼠的？真勇敢。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now have courage because I'm sending you to a stronger opponent.
But first in order to test your courage, hunt Familiars.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
鼓起勇氣吧，我要派你去對付更強的對手。
不過在那之前，先獵殺使魔，測試一下你的膽量。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Familiars will bite you so be careful.
They are mean.
They scare me so just hunt 5 and that should be enough.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
使魔會咬人，小心點。
它們可壞了。
我怕它們，所以獵殺5只就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
That will show me that you are brave.
Meow~!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
這樣就能證明你很勇敢了。
喵～！

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
I don't have anything...
......
What do you want meow? Familiars are waiting to fight with you, hurry up, move~!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
我沒什麼要說的……
……
你還愣著幹嗎，喵？使魔正等著和你打呢。快去，動起來～！

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
If you can't kill the Tarou you might get all kinds of dirty diseases.
So be proud of yourself and do your best to kill them.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
白鼠身上髒兮兮的，不趕緊消滅它們可能會染上各種病。
所以，為自己感到驕傲，好好努力把它們消滅吧。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
I will help you a little.
Here, I have recovered your strengh meow..
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
我來幫你一點忙。
來，我幫你恢復體力了，喵……

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
You are great meow~
You killed them so quickly!
Meow...
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
你真厲害，喵～
這麼快就把它們消滅了！
喵……

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now you are not scared of bugs and tarou at all.
Thanks for participating in the Conquer the Culvert training mission.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
現在你已經一點也不怕盜蟲和白鼠了。
感謝你參加“征服下水道”訓練任務。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Now go back to the headquarters and ask Instructor Boya to make sure he has the beautiful tuna...
I will be waiting here.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
回總部去找教官博雅，讓他確認那條美麗的金槍魚還在……
我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Do you know how to get to the Eden Group Headquarters?
Prontera is the closest city from here.
Go to Prontera and find an Eden Group Teleporter.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
你知道怎麼去伊甸園總部嗎？
離這裡最近的城市是普隆德拉。
去那裡找伊甸園傳送師吧。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Familiars are really scary.
They're always flying.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
使魔真的很可怕。
它們總是在天上飛。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
It's the last course so cheer up.
I will help you a little.
Here, I have recovered your strengh meow..
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
這是最後一項訓練了，加油。
我來幫你一點忙。
來，我幫你恢復體力了，喵……

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
You've completed 'Conquer the Culvert'.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters to report to Boya.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
你完成了“征服下水道”訓練。
回伊甸園總部向博雅報告吧。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
Boya might eat my tuna while he is waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
博雅等你的時候，說不定會把我的金槍魚吃掉。

scripts.text:
[Timid Cat]
How are you meeow?
Did you volunteer to conquer the Culvert?
You are a member of the Edgen Group for sure.
You are helping to make the world a better place.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的貓]
你好呀，喵？
你自願參加“征服下水道”訓練了嗎？
你肯定是伊甸園的成員。
你正在為讓世界變得更美好而努力。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hey, how are you?
Good to see you~
Are you going inside?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
嘿，最近怎麼樣？
見到你真高興～
要進去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Umm...?
You are not the one I am waiting for.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
嗯……？
你不是我要等的人。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Hello?
Since I got a report, I was waiting for you.
You came here to join the training mission, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你好？
我收到訊息後就在這裡等你了。
你是來參加訓練任務的吧？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Have you ever entered this cave before?
I don't know if you already heard some stories in this village.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你以前進過這個洞窟嗎？
不知道你有沒有聽村裡的人說起過這裡的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
There are many of dead souls that change their appearance as if they are real people and make threatening remarks.
It's too bad, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
這裡有許多亡魂，會偽裝成活人，還會出言恐嚇。
真讓人頭疼，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
That's why we chose this place as step 2 of the battle training mission.
This step is called 'Conquer Ghost Cave~'.
Help people to enjoy their nights comfortably.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
所以我們把這裡選作戰鬥訓練的第二階段。
這一階段叫“征服幽靈洞窟～”。
讓大家夜裡也能安心生活吧。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
There are many dangerous things there. Hmm...
To you the 1st floor is enough.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
裡面有不少危險的東西。嗯……
以你的實力，待在一樓就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Lets conquer the dangerous ghost cave...
Kill the bone Skeletons in there.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
去征服這座危險的幽靈洞窟吧……
消滅裡面的邪骸戰士。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
The bones are from Skeletons.
Actually Skeletons or just normal bones are all the same but...
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
這些骨頭都是邪骸戰士留下的。
不過邪骸戰士和普通骨頭好像也沒什麼區別……

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Skeletons are one of the basic undead classes.
Undead never ever. Hunt 15 undead Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
邪骸戰士是最基礎的亡靈之一。
不過亡靈可不會真正死去。去獵殺15只邪骸戰士。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
If you feel like you're in danger don't hesitate to just leave.
You're not worried about getting hurt are you?
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
覺得危險的話就別猶豫，直接撤退。
你不會是怕受傷吧？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Did you get how the undead work?
As you know undead never die so, blessing of live person it's same as curse to them.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
明白亡靈的特性了嗎？
如你所知，亡靈不會真正死去，所以活人的祝福對它們來說就像詛咒。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
So... skills which can save people like Heal and Resurrection.
Those things are really strong attacks to undead class.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
所以，能拯救活人的治癒術和復活術，
對亡靈來說反而是非常強力的攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Anyway... that's it..
Next... I guess you already see while you were killing Skeletons.
Some green things are picking up all of the stuff dropped by the dead monsters.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
總之就是這樣……
接下來，你獵殺邪骸戰士時應該已經看到了：
有些綠色的東西正在撿走魔物掉落的物品。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Do you know Porings? Maybe they are related to them.
They look really bad, maybe they have been eating poison or something.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你知道波利吧？那些東西或許和波利有關。
它們看起來狀態很差，可能是吃了什麼有毒的東西。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Ok if you're ready go and kill those Poporings.
You should hunt 10 of them.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
準備好了就去消滅那些變異波利吧。
獵殺10只。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Skeletons are basic undead.
Use the Heal or Resurrection skill.
If you can.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
邪骸戰士是基礎的亡靈。
用治癒術或復活術攻擊它們，
如果你會的話。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Just in case I will recover all your energy.
It's the last step so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
以防萬一，我先幫你恢復體力。
這是最後一步了，小心點。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Did you get back what the Poporing stole?
This cave is really deep and there are lots of precious things that they could have picked up.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
拿回變異波利偷走的東西了嗎？
這個洞窟很深，它們可能撿走了不少貴重物品。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You did really great job. Excellent.
The 1st floor is safer now. Thanks for helping.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你做得非常出色。太棒了。
一樓現在安全多了，多謝幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You've completed all of the training missions so go back to the headquarters and get approval from the flashy Rune Knight.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
訓練任務全都完成了。回總部找那位閃亮的盧恩騎士確認吧。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You might get a new uniform.
Haha. I will keep tabs on your progression.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
你可能會得到一套新制服。
哈哈，我會留意你的進步。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Poporings are stronger than you expect.
If you treat them the same as a normal Poring it will get you in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[卡爾]
要消滅亡靈嗎？
盡力讓這個世界更安全吧。
這也是伊甸園的目標之一。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Just in case I will recover all your energy.
It's the last step so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
哎呀，你是我小隊的成員。
怎麼跑到這裡來了？想找危險嗎？

scripts.text:
[Karl]
I already informed Boya at the Eden Group headquarters.
If you go there he will give you a big welcome.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
這裡有只非常強大的首領魔物。
探索時要小心。

scripts.text:
[Karl]
You will get a new uniform, aren't you excited?
Hahaha..
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
你看什麼？
我們又沒有關係……

scripts.text:
[Karl]
Killing undead?
Do your best to make the world safer.
It's one of the goals of the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
你好？
怎麼跑到這裡來了？想找危險嗎？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Oops.
You are a member of my group.
Why did you come here, are you looking for danger?
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
征服蟻穴

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
One of the strongest boss monsters is in here.
Be careful when exploring here.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
只是想見見你

scripts.text:
[Cloud ]
What are you looking at?
We are not related to each other, are we...
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
我在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Hello?
Why did you come here, looking for danger?
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
嗯？你說要“征服蟻穴”？
你是來參加訓練的學員啊。
那你來對地方了。

scripts.text: Conquer Ant Hell
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
先給你介紹一下蟻穴。
螞蟻在沙地裡挖出洞穴，直通地表，這就是蟻穴。

scripts.text: Just wanted to meet you
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
沙子會一點點灌進洞裡。
有人踩上去，就會從沙面上的洞口掉進蟻穴……

scripts.text: Where am I?
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
掉進去可不容易活著出來。
不過對我們來說，這種事很平常，所以也談不上什麼生死關頭。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Uh. Conquer Ant Hell? Did you say that?
You are a trainee.
You have come to the right place.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
各種螞蟻都搬來這裡住了。
裡面還有隻叫蟻后的首領魔物，千萬要小心。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
At first I will explain about Ant Hell.
Ants dug a cave in the sand and it is linked to the surface. That's Ant Hell.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
好，先試著獵殺最弱的螞蟻。
最弱的叫白蟻。
就在下面。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Sand flowed into the hole gradually.
If anyone steps on the hole they will fall into the cave through the hole in the sand..
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
螞蟻遭到攻擊時會互相支援。
小心應對，獵殺15只白蟻。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
It's hard to survive from there.
To us it seems like a normal happening so it isn't a matter of survival like to normal people.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
……
哈哈……你在開玩笑吧？
沙漠天氣這麼熱，你都累壞了。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Many kinds of ants have come to live here.
There is a boss monster named Maya so you should be more cautious.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
我可是很忙的。
有個學員說要來找我，到現在還沒出現，真讓人著急。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Ok let's try to hunt the weakest ant first.
Pierre is the name of the weakest ant.
They are just down here.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
好，先獵殺最弱的螞蟻。
它叫白蟻。
就在下面。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
In the case of ants, they assist eachother when attacked.
Be careful and kill 15 Pierre ants.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
螞蟻遇襲時會互相支援。
小心應對，獵殺15只白蟻。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
......
Haha... are you joking?
You are exhausted from the extremely hot weather in the desert.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
……
哈哈……你在開玩笑吧？
沙漠天氣熱得讓你精疲力盡了。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
I am a busy man.
One of the trainees was planning to visit me but that person still hasn't showed yet. I am getting nervous.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
我可是很忙的。
有個學員說要來找我，卻一直沒出現，我都等得著急了。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Where you are?
You are in Anth Hell southwest of Morocc.
Morocc is the closest city, northeast of here.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
你現在在哪裡？
你在夢羅克西南方的蟻穴裡。
離這裡最近的城市是東北方的夢羅克。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Hey, what was it?
Maybe you saw an Andre when you were hunting Pierre.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
嘿，怎麼了？
你獵殺白蟻時應該看到變異晶片了吧？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Well, now let's hunt Andre aswel.
Ahah the way you're looking at me, ''why didn't I ask you to do this all at once'' right?
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
好吧，那現在也去獵殺變異晶片。
哈哈，看你這眼神，是不是在想：“為什麼不一開始就一起交代？”

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Ain't it more fun this way?
Hey, now your next target is 15 Andre!
You are strong so it will be fine!
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
這樣不是更有趣嗎？
下一個目標是15只變異晶片！
你這麼強，一定沒問題！

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
If you can't find Andre go deeper into the cave.
Ah, and be careful of Maya.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
找不到變異晶片的話，就往洞窟深處走。
還有，小心蟻后。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
What do you think of Ant Hell?
Can you stay longer?
Ok, I will recover your strengh so, keep going.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
覺得蟻穴怎麼樣？
還能繼續堅持嗎？
好，我幫你恢復體力，繼續加油。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Great. You seem to have killed all of the Andre.
How do you think about fighting ants?
Was it good?
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
很好，看來你已經消滅了所有變異晶片。
和螞蟻戰鬥感覺怎麼樣？
還不錯吧？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Hey, cheer up.
To conquer Ant Hell you have one step left.
You might have guessed your next target already.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
嘿，打起精神來。
征服蟻穴只剩最後一步了。
你應該已經猜到下一個目標了。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Vitata!
How can I say... He seems like honey.
Pierre is a worker. Andre is a guardian and so... Vitata is like a mother.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
黑蟻！
該怎麼說呢……它們像是蟻穴裡的蜂蜜。
白蟻是工蟻，變異晶片是衛兵……那麼黑蟻就像母親。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
They are really kind to kids and women but don't show any pity to ants.
Hunt the Vitata who takes care of the ant eggs.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
它們對幼蟻和蟻后照顧有加，但對其他螞蟻可不會手下留情。
去獵殺負責照料蟻卵的黑蟻。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
If somebody falls into Ant Hell it might be a bit safer than before.
Now it's the last step so cheer up and let's kill 10 Vitata.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
有人掉進蟻穴時，至少現在會安全些了。
最後一步了，打起精神來，去獵殺10只黑蟻。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
If you feel you're in too much danger. Just come back.
I will heal you.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
覺得太危險的話就回來，我會幫你治療。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
See, to cheer you up I will heal you until you finish the training.
Chin up and cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
看，為了讓你堅持到訓練結束，我會一直幫你治療。
抬起頭，振作起來。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Oh... it might have been an anoying fight.
You finished so fast.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
哦……這場戰鬥可能挺煩人的吧。
不過你完成得真快。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Good job. Go back to the headquarters and report.
You've completed the training quickly.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
幹得好。回總部彙報吧。
你很快就完成了訓練。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
You will get good news.
You did a really good job even under the hot weather.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
有好訊息等著你。
這麼熱的天氣裡，你還完成得這麼出色。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
See, to cheer up I will heal you until you finish the training.
Chin up and cheer up.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
看，為了讓你堅持到訓練結束，我會一直幫你治療。
抬起頭，振作起來。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Just Vitata, isn't that an easy opponent?
If you see Maya just run away.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
就對付黑蟻而已，不算難吧？
看到蟻后就趕快逃。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
It's enough to say that you've conquered Ant Hell.
Aren't you getting used to it here?
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
可以說你已經征服蟻穴了。
你也漸漸習慣這裡了吧？

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
Go back to the headquarters and report that you completed the mission, hurry up
you will receive good news.
You will receive the Eden Group uniform aswel.
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
趕快回總部報告任務完成。
你會收到好訊息，
還有一套伊甸園制服。

scripts.text:
[Cloud]
I am really proud of the Eden Group.
Does the uniform look good on me?
Haha...
scripts.translation:
[克勞德]
我真的為伊甸園感到驕傲。
這套制服穿在我身上好看嗎？
哈哈……

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Unbelievable why did you come here?
Um... You are not on the third step of the training?
Yeeee~ I'm excited~
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
真難以置信，你怎麼跑到這裡來了？
嗯……你不是該在訓練第三階段嗎？
耶～我好興奮～

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
I am a little bored waiting for trainees. Where are they?
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
等學員等得有點無聊了。他們人呢？

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Hello.
Why did you come here?
Umm... Aaaaa...
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你好。
你怎麼來這裡了？
嗯……啊啊……

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Why don't you join my group?
If you have interest in joining us,
you won't regret your decision.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
要不要加入我的小隊？
如果你有興趣加入，
保證不會後悔。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Hello.
Are you a trainee?
Yeah I can tell.
So shall we begin?
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你好。
你是來參加訓練的學員嗎？
我一看就知道了。
那我們開始吧？

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Actually I don't like this training mission much but anyway let me explain it to you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
其實我不太喜歡這項訓練，不過還是先給你說明一下。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
As you know this is Orc Village.
Orcs don't like humans.
They don't try to communicate with us. When they see humans they immediately attack us.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你知道的，這裡是獸人村。
獸人不喜歡人類，
也不願意和我們交流，一看到人就會立刻攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Sadly humans don't want to communicate with them either.
So we decided to take a strong approach towards them.
Actually we'd like to get rid of them all.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
遺憾的是，人類也不想和他們溝通。
所以我們決定採取強硬手段。
說實話，我們想把他們全部消滅。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
We're trying to conquer Orc Village.
It's the proper place to finish the beginners training mission for an adventurer like you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
我們正在攻佔獸人村。
對你這樣的冒險者來說，這裡正適合完成新手訓練。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
That's why we've chosen this place for this mission.
Ok, we don't have a lot of time so let's begin.
First let's eliminate the weakest one.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
所以我們選了這裡作為訓練地點。
時間不多，開始吧。
先消滅最弱的目標。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
It's better to kill them before they grow up.
Hunt 10 Orc Babies.
Don't pity them because when they grow up they become aggressive Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
趁它們還沒長大，最好先下手。
獵殺10只獸人嬰兒。
別心軟，它們長大後會變成兇悍的獸人戰士。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Good or bad this is how it is going to be.
Even if they are babies don't hesitate.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
不管你覺得對不對，事情就是這樣。
即使它們還是嬰兒，也別猶豫。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Great. Awesome.
It's not very pleasant so let's move on.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
很好，幹得漂亮。
這活兒不怎麼愉快，繼續吧。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
On the next step we will fight with Orc Warriors.
When Orc Babies grow up they become strong Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
下一階段要對付獸人戰士。
獸人嬰兒長大後就會變成強壯的獸人戰士。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
They all are powerful warriors.
When you were fighting Orc Babies, you probably have been attacked by them.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
它們都是強悍的戰士。
你獵殺獸人嬰兒時，應該已經遭到它們攻擊了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Now it's time to hunt 10 Orc Warriors.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
現在去獵殺10只獸人戰士。
遇到危險就回來這裡避難。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
There are Orc Warriors, Orc Ladies and Orc Babies in Orc Village.
They are really aggressive.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
獸人村裡有獸人戰士、獸人女士和獸人嬰兒。
它們都很兇猛。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You look tired I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你看起來累了，我來幫你恢復體力。
遇到危險就回來這裡避難。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Now you can move on to the next step.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
現在可以進入下一階段了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Exactly... now it's time to hunt Orc Ladies.
If you want to conquer Orc Village completely, you should kill them before they have more Orc Babies.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
沒錯……現在該去獵殺獸人女士了。
想徹底攻下獸人村，就得在她們生出更多獸人嬰兒前行動。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
But you don't need to kill all of them.
Go and hunt 10 Orc Ladies.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
不過不用趕盡殺絕。
去獵殺10只獸人女士就行。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You can already feel the strong power from outside...
Don't hesitate to attack them.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你已經感受到外面那股強大的氣息了吧……
別猶豫，主動攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You should be exhausted by now.
But you still have more targets, understand.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你現在應該累壞了。
不過還有更多目標，明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你看起來累了，我來幫你恢復體力。
遇到危險就回來這裡避難。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Great job.
Now you should understand how the orc tribe works here in Orc Village.
You've followed the training mission well under hot and humid circumstances.
You have now completed the 'Conquer Orc Village!' training mission. Congratulations.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
幹得好。
現在你應該瞭解獸人村裡獸人部族的情況了。
你在又熱又潮溼的環境下順利完成了訓練。
“征服獸人村！”訓練任務完成，恭喜。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Go back and report to the Eden Group headquarters.
I'm sure they will have good news for you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
回伊甸園總部報告吧。
我想他們會給你帶來好訊息。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Orc Lady is the last target.
Cheer up~!
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
獸人女士是最後一個目標。
加油～！

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你看起來累了，我來幫你恢復體力。
遇到危險就回來這裡避難。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
You have completed the training mission.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters and report there.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
訓練任務完成了。
回伊甸園總部報告吧。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Have you come here to join in the training?
You look like an expert.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你是來參加訓練的嗎？
看起來像是個老手。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
This isn't a good place to talk so let's hurry.
This place is linked with the dungeon of Orc Village.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
這裡不適合聊天，快走吧。
這裡連著獸人村地下洞窟。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Can you see that way.
There is a cave under the ground, normal orcs don't come here.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
看到那邊了嗎？
地下有個洞窟，普通獸人不會來這裡。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
The safest place is in here.
There are many undead monsters down there.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
這裡是最安全的地方。
下面有很多不死系魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
The undead monsters are dangerous and threatening.
Don't hesitate when fighting them.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
不死系魔物既危險又兇猛。
戰鬥時別猶豫。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Now hunt those undead monsters down there.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
現在去獵殺下面的不死系魔物。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Try to hunt 20 Orc zombies in the dungeon.
They are really well organized.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
去地下洞窟獵殺20只獸人腐屍。
它們配合得相當有組織。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
They will attack you anywhere without hesitating.
May Freya bless you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
它們無論在哪裡都會毫不猶豫地攻擊你。
願芙蕾雅保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
It's different from what you saw in Payon, right?
Although you managed to kill the Orc Zombies, you can't be sure you are much stronger..
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
和你在斐揚見到的情況不同吧？
雖然你殺死了獸人腐屍，但還不能掉以輕心……

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
So don't go deeper into that cave or you will die for sure.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
別再深入洞窟了，否則肯定會喪命。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
The next target is the Orc Skeleton who was walking next to the Orc Zombies.
Hunt 20 Orc Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
下一個目標是獸人腐屍旁邊徘徊的邪骸獸人。
獵殺20只邪骸獸人。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
It's the last step of the training mission in the Orc Dungeon.
It's all up to you.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
這是獸人地下城訓練任務的最後一步。
接下來就看你的了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Ok, cheer up and see you again.
Hunt 20 Orc Skeletons.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
好，打起精神來，回頭見。
記得獵殺20只邪骸獸人。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Can you stay longer?
You look tired, I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
還能堅持嗎？
你看起來累了，我來幫你恢復體力。
遇到危險就回來這裡避難。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Your training mission has been completed.
Go back to the Eden Group headquarters and report.
I would like to say more in detail but I'm getting so tired.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
訓練任務完成了。
回伊甸園總部報告吧。
我本想再詳細說說，不過已經累壞了。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Recently trainees have come here more and more so, I can't sleep at all.
I mean not due to you.
Anyway I will inform the group so go there and report.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
最近來這裡的學員越來越多，我都睡不好了。
不是在怪你哦。
總之我會通知總部，你回去報告吧。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Can you stay longer?
You look tired I will recover your health.
If you are in trouble just come back here to safety.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
還能堅持嗎？
你看起來累了，我來幫你恢復體力。
遇到危險就回來這裡避難。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Don't you have to report back to the Eden Group headquarters?
I am so tired leave me alone.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
你不該回伊甸園總部報告了嗎？
我累壞了，別來煩我。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
Uh? What Orc? Explore the dungeon?
You are having such a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
嗯？什麼獸人？探索地下城？
你也太辛苦了吧。

scripts.text:
[Hooksha]
This place is really good to take a rest because Orcs don't come here.
Ho hum...
scripts.translation:
[胡克沙]
這裡很適合休息，獸人不會來。
哈啊……

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
How did you get so deep in this ocean city?
Ah, that symbol is of our group.
You're a trainee for sure.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
你怎麼深入海之都到這裡來了？
啊，那個標誌是我們小隊的。
你肯定是來受訓的吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
What? You aren't?
I... see... I see...
Ok... keep going.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
什麼？你不是？
我……明白了……
好吧……繼續走吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]

scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
潮溼的環境讓我的皮膚變得很柔軟。
而且我的手指和腳趾居然沒有連在一起，真神奇。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]

Now I love this environment so much.
It's really calm...
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
伊甸園把我派來時，我既震驚又害怕。
現在我卻很喜歡這裡的環境。
這裡真的很寧靜……

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
How did you get so deep in this ocean city?
Ah, that symbol is of our group.
You're a trainee for sure.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
你怎麼深入海之都到這裡來了？
啊，那個標誌是我們小隊的。
你肯定是來受訓的吧。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Good to see you!
Alright, look down.
Ancient buildings are sleeping under the water. They were actually built under the sea.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
很高興見到你！
來，往下看。
古老的建築沉睡在海底，它們原本就是建在水下的。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]

But if you see over there... yes right there.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]

不過你看那邊……對，就是那裡。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]

He is called a Merman and is a really professional warrior.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]
看到那個拿著危險長矛的人形魚了嗎？
那是人魚士兵，是非常專業的戰士。

scripts.text:
[Callandiva]
Okay, go and hunt 15 Merman.
That will be your 1st training mission here.
scripts.translation:
[卡蘭蒂瓦]

這是你在這裡的第一項訓練任務。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

我們會把援助送到需要幫助的地方。像你這樣的冒險者越多，我們賺得也越多。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
If you're interested, talk to Raim.
Raim's a good guy.
Hahaha..
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
有興趣的話就去找萊姆。
萊姆人不錯。
哈哈哈……

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: It's nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
I guess I have no business with you then.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
那我想我們沒什麼可談的了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Well, I'm an instructor for Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
嗯，我是伊甸園的指導員。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
I'm here to give you missions based on your current base level.
These missions are not very difficult to do.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
我會根據你的基礎等級安排任務。
這些任務都不難。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
I am the senior instructor here at Eden Group.
What do you say are you up for the challenge?
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
我是伊甸園的資深指導員。
怎麼樣，敢接受挑戰嗎？

scripts.text: Not today I'm not.
scripts.translation: 今天還是算了。

scripts.text: Okay, I'll try.
scripts.translation: 好，我試試看。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Really?
That's so sad.
When you finish these missions I will even give you a pretty decent reward.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
真的嗎？
太遺憾了。
完成這些任務後，我還會給你相當不錯的獎勵呢。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Yeah!
Ok, let me check what mission you should get ok?
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
太好了！
我看看該給你安排什麼任務。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Well... I know that you've got the heart but you're just a little too weak to help.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
嗯……我知道你有這份心，可惜你現在實力還不夠，幫不上忙。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Ok, I guess you're the bare minimum level for these missions.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
好吧，你剛好達到這些任務的最低等級要求。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Let's see...
Your level would suggest that Comodo is just too easy for you.
Yeah, here we go.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
我看看……
以你的等級，克魔島的任務太簡單了。
對了，就這個。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Ah, ok so for you...
Hmm where do I send you?
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
啊，好吧，適合你的任務……
嗯，該派你去哪裡呢？

scripts.text: [Instructor Ur]
scripts.translation: [指導員烏爾]

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Sorry, but your basic level should be at least 60 to help with these missions.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
抱歉，基礎等級至少要達到60級，才能參加這些任務。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Based on your level, I think that the Comodo area suits you.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
按你的等級，克魔島一帶應該很適合你。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Do you know where Comodo is?
You can get there by going to Morocc and then through Pharos Lighthouse.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
你知道克魔島在哪兒嗎？
先到夢羅克，再經過燈塔島就能抵達。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Comodo is a small city on the coast with many caves.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
克魔島是海岸邊的一座小城，周圍有許多洞窟。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Look for the cave located to the north. There's someone there named Romeo.
You know? As in Romeo, Romeo, wherefore art thou Romeo.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
去北邊的洞窟找一個叫羅密歐的人。
知道莎士比亞那句臺詞吧？“羅密歐，羅密歐，你在哪裡？”

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Go there are get the mission from him.
Well, then come back here alive when you're done!
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
去找他接任務。
辦完後記得活著回來！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Do you know where Glast Heim is?
If there was a tragic accident now, the capital of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom could revert back to there.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
你知道葛拉斯特海姆在哪兒嗎？
那裡曾是盧恩米德加茲王國的首都。要是現在發生什麼悲劇，首都說不定又會遷回那裡。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Well, if it wasn't infested with undead monsters, it would become the new capitol of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
要不是亡靈魔物橫行，葛拉斯特海姆早就成了盧恩米德加茲的新首都。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Please, come back alive.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
一定要活著回來。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
There an industrial city called Einbroch.
You know it? It's a city covered in smog.
It's a pretty gloomy city come to think of it.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
那邊有座工業城市叫艾音布羅克。
你知道吧？整座城都籠罩在煙霧裡。
想想還真是個陰沉的地方。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Anyways, go to Einbroch and find the Dispatched Instructor there. He should be in the field south of the main city.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
總之，去艾音布羅克找派遣指導員。他應該在主城南邊的野外。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
We have rewards for you.
I'm sure Romeo gave you some items, but we brought more useful things.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
我們給你準備了獎勵。
羅密歐應該給過你一些東西，不過我們這邊還有更實用的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Do you know where the weapon storage is at?
Go out through that large blue door and walk to the end of the hallway.
Ask the Blacksmith, and he will give you new equipment.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
知道武器倉庫在哪兒嗎？
穿過那扇大藍門，走到走廊盡頭。
找鐵匠領取新裝備。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
And the 2nd stage training and missions start at level 70, so come back then.
Don't forget, I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
第二階段訓練和任務要到70級才開放，到時候再來。
別忘了，我會等著你。

scripts.text: I want to start training.
scripts.translation: 開始訓練。

scripts.text: I'm just visiting.
scripts.translation: 我只是來看看。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Hmm... You have a good form!
Let me see....
Which location would suit you...?
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
嗯……狀態不錯嘛！
讓我看看……
哪個地點適合你呢？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Really? At your level, I think you can easily complete the top class missions..
I'll be here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
真的嗎？以你的等級，最高階任務應該輕輕鬆鬆。
改主意的話，我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text: [Instructor Ur]
scripts.translation: [指導員烏爾]

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Ah, this place should be good!
Do you know where Glast Heim is?
If it wasn't for that terrible accident, Glast Heim would still be
the capital of Rune-Midgarts, not Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
啊，這個地方不錯！
你知道葛拉斯特海姆在哪兒嗎？
要不是那場可怕的災難，葛拉斯特海姆如今仍會是盧恩米德加茲的首都，而不是普隆德拉。

scripts.text: [Instructor Ur]
scripts.translation: [指導員烏爾]

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Anyways, that ancient castle is now full of undead monsters .
It's especially bad around the Abbey in the south.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
總之，那座古堡如今遍佈亡靈魔物。
南邊修道院附近尤其嚴重。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
All of those undead monsters come from the underground graveyard
Well... I guess you don't have to go all the way into the graveyard...
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
那些亡靈魔物都來自地下墓地。
不過……你應該不用一路深入墓地。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Once you get to the Abbey you'll see our unit member stationed in front of the entrance.
Follow his instructions to help clear out that area.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
到修道院後，你會看到我們的隊員守在入口處。
聽從他的指示，協助清理周圍區域。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Please come back alive.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
一定要活著回來。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Anyways, good job. I'm glad you're not hurt
The Blacksmith BK said he'll reinforce your weapon.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
總之，幹得好。很高興你平安無事。
鐵匠BK說要幫你強化武器。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
You know where the Blacksmith is at right??
Go out through the blue door, to the end of the hallway.
BK is a great blacksmith, he'll make your weapon stronger.
What are you waiting for?
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
知道鐵匠在哪兒吧？
穿過藍色大門，走到走廊盡頭。
BK是個好鐵匠，能讓你的武器變得更強。
還等什麼？

Good job!
