穿過藍色大門，走到走廊盡頭。
BK是個好鐵匠，能讓你的武器變得更強。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
By the way, it looked like Michael had something to tell you as well
Go talk to him, he's at the weapon storage as well.
Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
對了，邁克爾好像也有事要跟你說。
去武器倉庫找他吧。
快去。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Also, sometimes Michael needs help, so if you have time try to help him out.
I'm sure he'll reward you for your time.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
邁克爾有時也需要人幫忙，有空就去幫幫他吧。
我想他會給你一些報酬。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
I just realized... this was your first mission, wasn't it?
You must not have gotten the basic equipments yet, right?
Pick them up at the weapon storage.
Ask the Blacksmith Michael and he'll give you the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
我剛想起來……這應該是你的第一個任務吧？
你還沒領基礎裝備，對吧？
去武器倉庫找鐵匠邁克爾，他會給你裝備。

scripts.text:
So, have you been in ^4d4dff{0}^000000 yet?
Didn't I tell you to go there?
Go there first and then come back to me. Okay?
scripts.translation:
那麼，你去過^4d4dff{0}^000000了嗎？
我不是叫你去那裡嗎？
先去一趟，再回來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
Hmm.. Not bad ...
You must be getting a hang of this..
Let's go with a simple mission this time
scripts.translation:
嗯……不錯……
看來你已經上手了……
這次安排個簡單的任務吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
There is a industrial city called Einbroch.
You've heard of it? It's a city clouded with pollution.
You'll appreciate the environment here so much more after visiting that city...
We should all be thankful.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
有座工業城市叫艾音布羅克。
聽說過嗎？那裡被汙染的煙霧籠罩。
去過那裡後，你一定會更珍惜這裡的環境……大家都該心懷感激。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Anyways, go out to the field south of Einbroch and you'll see the Dispatched Instructor.
I'm sure he'll recognize you first.
Don't forget to bring the Eden Group badge.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
去艾音布羅克南邊的野外找派遣指導員。
他應該一眼就能認出你。
別忘了帶伊甸園徽章。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
The city's pollution is unbearable
But the surrounding fields are relatively clean...
This should be pretty easy for you.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
城裡的汙染讓人受不了，
不過周圍的野外還算乾淨……
這對你應該很容易。

scripts.text:
Uh-huh....
Hmm...
You seem like a cool-headed person. What do you think about the ice caves?
scripts.translation:
嗯哼……
嗯……
你看起來挺冷靜的。覺得冰洞怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
North of the city of Rachel is a cave filled with ice.
Find the Dispatched Instructor there.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
拉赫城北邊有個冰雪覆蓋的洞窟。
去那裡找派遣指導員。

scripts.text:
Well, well...
I don't even know where to send you now.
I'm sure you are familiar with most places around here
scripts.translation:
哎呀……
我都不知道現在該派你去哪兒了。
附近大部分地方你應該都很熟了吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Then, should I send you somewhere farther this time?
There is a Cat Paw Agent here.
Do you see him over there?
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
那這次派你去遠一點的地方如何？
這裡有位貓爪特派員。
看到那邊那位了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Through him, you can get to Ash Vacuum pretty easily .
Since there is a Expedition Camp there...
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
通過他就能輕鬆前往異世界。
遠征營地就在那邊……

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
All you have to do is find the Eden Group agent there.
Tell him I sent you, and he'll give you instructions.
You can explore the new world
It's like a vacation isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
找到那裡的伊甸園特派員就行。
告訴他是我派你去的，他會給你指示。
你還能順便探索新世界，
就當是度假吧？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
Hahaha!
.. Maybe I'll go instead of sending you.
Anyways, their names are Ma~ something... I don't know.
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
哈哈哈！
……說不定我會自己去，不派你去了。
總之，他們的名字好像是“瑪～”什麼的，我也記不清了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Ur]
So, the mission, once again, is finding our agent at the Midgard Expedition Camp.
Isn't this the easiest mission you've ever had?
Don't forget my present when you come back~!
scripts.translation:
[指導員烏爾]
再說一次，任務就是去米德加爾特遠征營地找我們的特派員。
這大概是你做過最簡單的任務吧？
回來時別忘了給我帶禮物～！

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
How are you?
Comodo has the best weather in the whole world.
Even during the winter, Comodo has great weather.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
最近怎麼樣？
克魔島的天氣是全世界最好的。
就算冬天，天氣也很舒服。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
How are you?
You were sent here by Instructor Ur right?
Did you come here for a quest?
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
最近怎麼樣？
你是烏爾指導員派來的吧？
是來接任務的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
So, how good of an explorer are you now?
You've fought these before, so clearing this cave should be possible.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
你現在的探索能力怎麼樣？
這些魔物你以前對付過，清理這個洞窟應該沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
As a test of the difficulty of this cave
Go defeat 3 Stalactic Golems.
Watch out for other monsters as well.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
先來測試一下這座洞窟的難度。
去擊敗3只鍾乳巨石怪。
也要小心其他魔物。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
You must go through this cave to the outside.
Don't forget to defeat the Stalactic Golems you run into on the way.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
你得穿過洞窟到外面去。
路上遇到鍾乳巨石怪，別忘了擊敗它們。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I always give the same test to the trainees that come here..
I've never seen anyone pass it so perfectly like you did.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
我給來這裡的學員出的都是同一項測試……
可從沒見過有人像你一樣輕鬆漂亮地完成。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Do you know why?
Comodo is surrounded by the ocean and caves.
Seasonal changes don't make any difference in the temperature here.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
知道為什麼嗎？
克魔島四周都是海和洞窟，
所以這裡幾乎不受季節變化影響。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Take it easy here.
This area is a place for relaxation.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
在這裡放鬆一下吧。
這裡就是用來休息的地方。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I don't know if this will fit you well
Why don't you just try it.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
不知道這件東西適不適合你，
不如試試看。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
The thing about this cave is that, many monsters are created from stones.
If you stay cautious, they shouldn't be too threatning...
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
這座洞窟裡的許多魔物都是石頭做的。
只要小心些，它們應該不難對付……

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
But most of them have range attacks..
And sometimes a really strong one roams around.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
不過大多數都會遠端攻擊……
而且有時還會有特別強的傢伙在附近遊蕩。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Well... this is the reason why you train right?
Let's try taking on one of the big monsters
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
這就是訓練的意義嘛，對吧？
來試著挑戰一隻大型魔物吧。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
'They are called 'Stalactic Golem'.
Try defeating some of them.
Not too difficult, right?
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
它們叫鍾乳巨石怪。
試著打倒幾隻。
不算太難吧？

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
As I said before, since Komodo is a city inside a cave..
Access to the outside world is mostly done through the east entrance, but...
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
正如我剛才說的，克魔島是一座洞窟裡的城市……
平時主要從東邊的出口通往外界，不過……

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Let's try going out through the north.
There should be things you can hunt out there.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
試試從北邊出去吧。
外面應該有些魔物可以狩獵。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
And instead of just walking out,
Let's kill about 10 Stalactic Golems on the way out.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
離開時別隻是走出去，
順路擊敗10只鍾乳巨石怪吧。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
So that, travelers coming from the north can safely walk through.
Remember, 10 Stalactic Golems. Then come to the other side of northern part of the cave
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
這樣從北邊來的旅人就能安全通行。
記住，擊敗10只鍾乳巨石怪，然後到洞窟北側的另一端來找我。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I'll be waiting outside.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
我會在外面等你。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Let me help you recover if you are tired.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
累了的話，我可以幫你恢復體力。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Ah, I see you didn't get lost.
Your skills at defeating those Stalactic Golems were better than I expected.
Just means you've improved that much.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
哦，看來你沒迷路。
你對付鍾乳巨石怪的本事比我預想的還好。
看來你確實進步了不少。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I see you didn't get lost.
But you didn't defeat enough Stalactic Golems..
Go back and defeat them.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
看來你沒迷路。
不過鍾乳巨石怪還沒打夠……
回去繼續打倒它們。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
You really got these by defeating the monsters?
I believe you. I want to get out of here anyways.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
這些真是你從魔物身上拿到的嗎？
我相信你。反正我也正想離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Didn't I already tell you the last task?
Defeat the monsters in this forest, and bring me the items I asked for.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
我不是已經告訴你最後一項任務了嗎？
去打倒森林裡的魔物，把我要求的物品帶回來。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
If you were sent from the Eden Group for training, wait for me at the town.
I'm waiting for a different trainee right now.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
如果你是伊甸園派來訓練的，就在城鎮裡等我。
我現在在等另一位學員。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
No no.. Not here.
I'm waiting for a different trainee right now.
Go back.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
不，不是這裡。
我現在在等另一位學員。
回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Ugh, It's way too hot here.
You can leave now.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
唉，這裡熱得受不了。
你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Now look around here
We're in a dense forest now.
There are Dryads and Wootans here...
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
看看周圍。
我們現在身處茂密的森林。
這裡有森林妖姬和伍坦戰士……

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
Next task is to clearing this area of monsters.
Bring me the following from the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
接下來要清理這一帶的魔物。
從它們身上收集以下物品交給我。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
5 Wootan Fighter's Shoulderguard
7 Dryad's Sharp Leaf
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
5個伍坦戰士護肩
7片森林妖姬的尖葉

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
This is the last test.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
這是最後一項測試。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I'll help you recover if you are tired.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
累了的話，我可以幫你恢復體力。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
There are no more training tasks here.
Go back and report to Ur.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
這裡的訓練任務已經全部完成。
回去向烏爾報告吧。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
5 Wootan Fighter's Shoulderguard
7 Dryad's Sharp Leaf
You must bring me those to pass this test.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
5個伍坦戰士護肩
7片森林妖姬的尖葉
帶齊這些物品才能通過測試。

scripts.text:
[Romeo]
I'll help you recover if you are tired.
scripts.translation:
[羅密歐]
累了的話，我可以幫你恢復體力。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Ah~ So bored.
You're not the one Ur sent, are you?
Oh~ That's okay.
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
啊～真無聊。
你不是烏爾派來的人吧？
哦～沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Oh oh!!
You're finally here!
I asked Ur to send someone to help me here!
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
哦哦！！
你終於來了！
我拜託烏爾派人來幫我！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Oh~ You are pretty strong!
I'm so glad that someone strong like you came.
I wouldn't have last long here by myself.
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
哦～你挺強的嘛！
能有你這樣的強者來幫忙，真是太好了。
要是隻有我一個人，早就撐不住了。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
...Oh you're back!
(Johan Opens the door and checks)
....!
Okay!!
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
……哦，你回來了！
（約翰開啟門檢視）
……！
好！！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Ugh, I still haven't found the thing I lost.
Hmm... I may need to wait for the next trainee before I can start looking again... Eep!
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
唉，我還沒找到丟掉的東西。
嗯……也許得等下一位學員來，我才能繼續找……咦！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
20 Wraiths!
I'll watch your back!.
... Of.. Course.. I'll fight too!
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
20只惡靈！
我會在後面掩護你！
……當……當然……我也會一起戰鬥！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
10 Evil Druids!
I'll watch your back, like last time.
... Of... Course... I'll fight them too!
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
10只邪骸黑暗祭司！
我會像上次一樣掩護你。
……當……當然……我也會一起戰鬥！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Go back and report to Ur.
That Glast Heim Abbey is clear now.
I need to stay and look for something... Good bye.
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
回去向烏爾報告吧。
葛拉斯特海姆修道院已經清理好了。
我得留下來找點東西……再見。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
This is Glast Heim Abbey.
Be careful, there are a lot of lost souls around here.
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
這裡是葛拉斯特海姆修道院。
小心，附近有很多迷失的靈魂。

scripts.text: What? I came for training..
scripts.translation: 什麼？我是來參加訓練的……

scripts.text:
[Johan]
No no, that's the same thing!
Your training mission is to help me clear out this Abbey!
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
不不，這本來就是一回事！
你的訓練任務就是幫我清理這座修道院！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Phew... It's been so tough.
I can't run in by myself, but then Gargoyles attack me out here..
Hahaha...
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
呼……真是難辦。
我不敢一個人衝進去，可待在外面又會被石像鬼攻擊……
哈哈哈……

scripts.text:
[Johan]
This abbey is our responsibilty.
Just like other monasteries, this one has an underground graveryad as well, but..
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
這座修道院歸我們負責。
和其他修道院一樣，這裡也有地下墓地，不過……

scripts.text:
[Johan]
As you well know, this castle... is not at a normal state.
I think that's causing these souls from being able to rest in peace.
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
你也知道，這座城堡……情況很不對勁。
我想這就是這些靈魂無法安息的原因。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Let's defeat the ones around here first, since going underground may be too much for just us.
I'll be testing how skilled you are as well...
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
先解決周圍的魔物吧。
只靠我們兩個人，深入地下恐怕太勉強了。
我也正好看看你的本事……

scripts.text:
[Johan]
First target are the Wraiths.
You can tell them apart by their strange laugh.
They look like demons, but we can't tell for sure...
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
第一個目標是惡靈。
它們的笑聲很奇怪，很容易辨認。
看起來像惡魔，不過我們也不能確定……

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Defeat 20 Wraiths.
I'll assist you from here!
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
擊敗20只惡靈。
我會在這裡支援你！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
By the way, did you see those other monsters besides the Wraiths?
They are the corrupted souls of priests.
They are called 'Evil Druid' as well.
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
對了，你看到惡靈以外的魔物了嗎？
那些是墮落牧師的靈魂，也叫邪骸黑暗祭司。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Let's take care of these Evil Druids this time.
10 of them.
You can do it right?
I believe in you!
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
這次來收拾邪骸黑暗祭司吧。
一共10只。
你做得到吧？我相信你！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Thank you! I really appreciate it!
I think I can enter without any worries now!
I hope those evil souls left it alone..
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
謝謝你！真是幫大忙了！
現在我可以放心進去看看了！
希望那些惡靈沒碰我的東西……

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Hehe, I'll put in a good word to Ur!
You're a valient and skilled exorcist!
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
嘿嘿，我會向烏爾好好誇誇你！
你真是個勇敢又能幹的驅魔師！

scripts.text:
[Johan]
You can go back to Eden now
I'll stay and clean up the rest, hehe
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
你可以回伊甸園了。
我留下來收拾剩下的，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Johan]
Uh... You didn't hear that did you?
Hahahahahahaha!!!
Hahahahaha!!
scripts.translation:
[約翰]
呃……你沒聽見剛才的話吧？
哈哈哈哈哈哈！！
哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
What?
....
Hmm, Ur sent you?
Oh, that training mission thing.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
什麼？
……
嗯？烏爾派你來的？
哦，那個訓練任務啊。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
What, You're done already?
I was just about to fall asleep... Oh well..
It can't be helped, I guess. Let's go to a different spot..
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
什麼，你已經做完了？
我剛才差點睡著……算了……
也沒辦法。我們換個地方吧……

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
So, have you punished those Porcellio's yet?
I don't think you're done yet right?
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
三葉鐵甲蟲收拾了嗎？
我看你還沒做完吧？

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Um...
I'm getting it done.
Hmm...
I'm still tired to finish...
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
嗯……
我會去處理的。
嗯……
我還是太累了，沒法做完……

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
The monsters are at the northern fields of Einbroch.
Find the Noxious...
Don't try to lie to me that you've finished hunting them.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
魔物在艾音布羅克北邊的野外。
去找廢氣魔……
別想騙我說你已經獵殺完了。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
I'm not a thief...
It's a hard living.
Nor is there any real ambition.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
我不是小偷……
日子不好過啊。
也沒什麼遠大志向。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
What are you looking at?
You want something from me?
Mind your own business, go away..
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
你看什麼？
想找我幹什麼？
少管閒事，走開……

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
What serious?
Have you made your report to Instructor Ur?
Einbroch has commissioned work out so that means more training.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
什麼大事？
你向烏爾指導員報告了嗎？
艾音布羅克釋出了委託，也就意味著又有訓練任務。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
You've came a long way, I won't make you do anything too tough, don't worry.
The fields outside of Einbroch isn't too bad.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
你走了這麼遠，我不會給你安排太難的任務，放心吧。
艾音布羅克外面的野地還算安全。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
And monsters here usually leaves me alone, so I can nap all day.
But there are some that bother me.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
這裡的魔物通常不來煩我，所以我可以睡上一整天。
不過有幾種總來搗亂。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Do you know Porcellios are?
Ugly looking insects... They steal too..
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
知道三葉鐵甲蟲嗎？
長得很醜的蟲子……還會偷東西。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Let's defeat some of them as a warm up.
There are plenty of them around here. 30 shouldn't be too hard right?
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
先拿它們熱熱身吧。
附近有很多，打30只應該不難吧？

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
I'm not holding a grudge just because they ate my lunch.
I'll be resting here until you're done.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
我才不是因為它們吃了我的午餐才記恨它們呢。
我就在這裡休息，等你回來。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
No, what are you talking about?
Go... with you?
You can by yourself right?
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
不，你在說什麼？
要我……跟你一起去？
你自己能行吧？

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Okay, next task!
People of Einbroch say that the pollution is really bad in the north.
They are worried that pollution will drift into the town.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
好，下一個任務！
艾音布羅克的居民說北邊的汙染很嚴重，
擔心汙染會飄進城裡。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
It's probably all those factories right there...
I guess I should still look into it.
The cause for the pollution... Find it and destroy it.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
大概是那邊的工廠造成的……
看來我還是得調查一下。
找出汙染源，然後摧毀它。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
30 Venomous and 5 Teddy Bears.
That should be good enough.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
30只毒魔和5只玩具熊。
應該就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
I'm sure you'll do fine without me watching.
To show my support, let me give you some EXP and HP recovery.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
我不盯著你，你也能做得很好。
讓我用經驗值和HP恢復來表示支援吧。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
The monsters are at the northern fields of Einbroch.
Okay then, be safe.
I'm going to take a nap.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
魔物在艾音布羅克北邊的野外。
那就小心點。
我要去睡一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
If you're hurt I'll heal you a bit.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
受傷的話，我會幫你治療一下。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Good. Those monsters have been bothering the Einbroch workers.
That was great..
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
很好，那些魔物一直在騷擾艾音布羅克的工人。
幹得不錯……

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
I have some things to report to Instructor Ur.
I've been watching you closely and you've done well. Go back to Ur and deliver this report.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
我有些情況要向烏爾指導員報告。
我一直在留意你的表現，你做得很好。回去把這份報告交給烏爾吧。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Yeah, if this is okay?
Ugh this is difficult.
I'll make you feel better though.
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
嗯……這樣可以嗎？
唉，這真麻煩。
不過我會讓你輕鬆一點。

scripts.text:
[Kiren]
Come practitioners?
Make things.
How convenient witchinya.
Heumnya. I'll sleep in one breath..
scripts.translation:
[基倫]
來訓練的人嗎？
做點東西。
真方便啊，喵。
嗯……我要一口氣睡過去了……

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
It's more than that~
Now where did the time go~
I thought you said you sent me~!
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
還不止這些呢～
時間都去哪兒了～
我還以為你說要派我出去呢～！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Ah... It's over...
Good!
Your skills have been verified.
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
啊……終於結束了……
很好！
你的實力已經得到驗證。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
The biggest stumbling block is dealing with the Siromas.
Have you hunted 30 yet?
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
最難對付的是小雪獸。
你已經獵殺30只了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Ohh!
You've brought everything.
Okay, so just one last thing...!
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
哦！
東西都帶齊了。
好，最後還有一件事……！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Have you finished hunting the 30 Siroma yet?
You've already done it once so this shouldn't be difficult...
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
30只小雪獸打完了嗎？
你之前做過一次了，這次應該不難……

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Were you there yet?
Other people have come and go since you've been here last.
Now I don't have to get the materials myself.
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
你終於來了？
你上次走後，這裡來了不少人。
現在我不用自己去收集材料了。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Alas, is there anywhere where the buildup of ice caps is more than here?
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
唉，還有哪裡會積起這麼多冰啊？

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
What is it? You'll help me. Is that right?
No, you don't have to do that.
I'm waiting for someone scheduled to help me.
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
怎麼了？你是想幫我，對吧？
不用了。
我在等另一個約好來幫忙的人。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
And you are?
Oh, you were sent here by Ur?
I don't know how long I've been waiting here in the snow.
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
你是？
哦，烏爾派你來的？
我都不知道自己在雪地裡等了多久。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
This is the ice dungeon of the northern plains.
Nothing like a cave that's cold the entire year.
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
這裡是北方平原的冰洞。
和那些一年到頭都很冷的洞窟可不一樣。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
So this is where the people of Rachel go for their ice supply.
But, this area is crawling with dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
拉赫的人會來這裡採冰。
不過附近有不少危險的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
One of those monsters is known as a Siroma.
They should be a good challenge for you.
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
其中一種叫小雪獸。
對你來說應該是個不錯的挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Okay, then go in the cave and find those Siroma.
It's cold in there but this job has to be done.
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
那就進洞找小雪獸吧。
裡面很冷，但工作還是得做。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
OH, sometimes
You be careful in there.
Well, good luck~!
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
哦，進去以後小心點。
祝你好運～！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Now, what have I happened to do next.
Those Siromas seem to be growing at a faster rate.
As before go and hunt 30 more Siromas and bring me some materials.
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
接下來得做什麼來著……
小雪獸似乎繁殖得越來越快。
和上次一樣，再獵殺30只小雪獸，帶些材料回來。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
And get this... Well...
Please listen carefully
30 Ice Cubic
1 Sweet Sauce
1 Milk
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
還有這些……嗯……
仔細聽好：
冰塊一角30個
甜醬汁1份
牛奶1瓶

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
I'm not just doing this for myself you know.
I'm doing this for everyone.
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
我可不只是為了自己才這麼做。
我是為了大家。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
That's the last of it anyways.
So hunt those Siromas and get the materials.
We understand each other?
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
總之這是最後的要求了。
去獵殺小雪獸，把材料收集齊。
說好了？

scripts.text: What about you?
scripts.translation: 那你呢？

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Me? Well of course... I'm going to stand guard here.
I... I'm a busy person!
Besides this is training so who are you to ask me what about me?
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
我？當然是……留在這裡站崗。
我……我可是很忙的！
再說這是訓練，你問我幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Go now!
Those Siromas are going to just get rowdier by the minute.
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
快去吧！
小雪獸只會越來越鬧騰。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Oh, you want help recovering your HP/SP huh?
You'll get nothing from me~!
What challenge would that be if I did that?
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
哦，你想讓我幫你恢復HP和SP啊？
我才不幫呢～！
那樣還算什麼挑戰？

scripts.text: ...... Look
scripts.translation: ……看著。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Yes, yes? Why not?
...
Oh, that's right! I'm supposed to give you something.
You've done enough, I know.
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
嗯嗯？為什麼不呢？
……
哦，對了！我應該給你點東西。
我知道，你已經做得夠多了。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
I'll inform Instructor Ur.
A few more stages left to go so don't worry!
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
我會向烏爾指導員彙報。
還剩幾個階段，別擔心！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Oh and congratulations!
This is the last training stage prepared!
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
對了，恭喜你！
這是最後一個訓練階段！

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
I guess I should do some of this myself~
Muahaha~
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
看來我也該親自做點事了～
哇哈哈～

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
And don't forget the 30 Ice Cubic, 1 Sweet Sauce, and 1 Milk.
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
別忘了帶冰塊一角30個、甜醬汁1份和牛奶1瓶。

scripts.text:
[Naomi]
Report back to Instructor Ur and report that the job is done.
Don't procrastinate.
scripts.translation:
[娜奧米]
回去向烏爾指導員報告任務完成。
別拖拖拉拉的。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
The proof that you have there.
You're here in paradise.
Instructor Ur sent you?
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
你手裡的證明……看來你來到樂園了。
是烏爾指導員派你來的？

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
So what's up?!
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
那，怎麼了？！

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Well, whatever the Nepenthes and Pinguicula proof has been collected.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
嗯，捕蟲堇和食人花的證明都收集齊了。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Oh, sorry.
I don't know much about the life of an adventurer.
I'm just a member of Eden Group...
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
哦，抱歉。
我不太瞭解冒險者的生活。
我只是伊甸園的一名成員……

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Can you find those two brothers?
Find out what's up with them.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
你能找到那兩兄弟嗎？
查清楚他們那邊出了什麼事。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
........
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
……

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Oh, my mistake.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
哦，是我搞錯了。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
How do you do?
Oh, so you're here for the training from Instructor Ur.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
你好。
哦，你是來參加烏爾指導員安排的訓練的。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Ok, I'm in a bit of a situation right now so I asked Instructor Ur to use his missions to help.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
好吧，我眼下正遇到點麻煩，所以請指導員烏爾用他的任務幫個忙。

scripts.text: A situation?
scripts.translation: 遇到麻煩了？

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Yes, 
Find Mine and do what he asks you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
是啊。
去找米內，按他說的去做。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
We dispatched him to do something and he hasn't done it yet so I'm guessing he's either chickened out or failed.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
我們派他去辦點事，可他到現在還沒辦完。我猜他要麼臨陣退縮了，要麼就是失敗了。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
So can you find him out there in Splendide Field?
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
你能去輝煌之野找到他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Find him and figure out what the heck he's up to please.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
麻煩你找到他，弄清楚他到底在搞什麼。

scripts.text: - You tell her about Meeru and Mine. -
scripts.translation: - 你把米魯和米內的事告訴了她。 -

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Yeah? Oh what?
This is not really...
Ok I'll go deal with them.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
是嗎？什麼？
這實在不太……
好吧，我去處理他們。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Well, whatever the Nepenthes and Pinguicula proof has been collected.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
好吧，不管怎樣，豬籠草和捕蟲堇的證明都收集齊了。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Your training is done so go back and talk to Instructor Ur.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
你的訓練結束了，回去找指導員烏爾吧。

scripts.text:
[Margaret]
Your training is done so go back and talk to Instructor Ur.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特]
你的訓練結束了，回去找指導員烏爾吧。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
You think I'll lose!
...?
All of them... Who're you?!
Mine is a stooge?
He sent you to watch me!?
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
你以為我會輸！
……？
你們全都……你是誰？！
米內是個跟班？
他派你來監視我？！

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Hmm yes I saw.
I knew I should've asked you to hunt more than 1.
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
嗯，我看到了。
早知道就該讓你多獵一隻了。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Is hunting the Nepenthes too much for you?
You seem a bit flushed.
Fine I'll heal you!
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
獵殺豬籠草對你來說太勉強了嗎？
你看起來臉都漲紅了。
好吧，我來給你治療！

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
I'll just be here making sure other people hunt the Nepenthes. I might ask them to hunt more than 1 who knows.
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
我就在這兒看著別人去獵殺豬籠草。說不定我也會讓他們多獵幾隻，誰知道呢。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Something wrong?
Did you have trouble with that Nepenthes...
.........hyuk huk.
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
怎麼了？
獵殺那隻豬籠草時遇到麻煩了嗎……
……咳、咳。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
What? Isn't that it?
... ...
Mine didn't send you did he?
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
什麼？不是這樣嗎？
……
米內沒派你來吧？

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
What? Isn't that it?
... ...
Mine didn't send you did he?
So why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
什麼？不是這樣嗎？
……
米內沒派你來吧？
那你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Margaret sent me
scripts.translation: 是瑪格麗特派我來的

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Ah, Margaret!
Mine and Margaret are always trying to mess with me because of my win-!
Gosh...
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
啊，是瑪格麗特！
米內和瑪格麗特老拿我的勝利說事，想捉弄我……
真是的……

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 發生什麼事了？

scripts.text: What do you win?
scripts.translation: 你贏了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
It all started with them bickering.
Margaret was asked to scout for both of us. It's like what you're doing now.
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
事情要從他們倆拌嘴說起。
瑪格麗特被叫去替我們兩邊偵察，就像你現在做的事一樣。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Mine said that he was strong enough to defeat any monster.
So I insisted that he go to either East or West of the camp and show me.
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
米內說自己強到能打敗任何魔物。
所以我就讓他去營地東邊或西邊看看，親自證明給我瞧。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Mine made an idle threat and huffed and puffed but didn't do anything.
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
米內只會放狠話，嘴上嚷嚷個不停，最後什麼也沒做。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Basically, Margaret didn't believe him and challenged him to kill 1 Nepenthes.
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
總之，瑪格麗特不相信他，就讓他去殺一隻豬籠草，算是給他出了道難題。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
So anyways now I'm charged with asking people to go and hunt 1 Nepenthes because of that bickering incident.
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
結果因為那次爭執，現在輪到我負責讓人去獵殺一隻豬籠草了。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
It's really not that difficult to hunt 1 so just go to the field East of here and kill one of them.
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
獵一隻其實沒那麼難，去這邊東面的原野殺一隻就行。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Anyways you've proven that you're stronger than Mine ever made himself out to be.
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
總之，你已經證明了自己比米內吹噓的強多了。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
Well anyways here's a small reward.
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
好了，給你一點小小的謝禮。

scripts.text:
[Meeru]
I'll just be here making sure other people hunt the Nepenthes. I might ask them to hunt more than 1 who knows.
scripts.translation:
[米魯]
我就在這兒看著別人去獵殺豬籠草。說不定我也會讓他們多獵幾隻，誰知道呢。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Oh cruel world...
...
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[米內]
這殘酷的世界啊……
……
你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Excellent!
Now I can go back to the camp and...
scripts.translation:
[米內]
太好了！
現在我可以回營地，然後……

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Come on 5 Pinguicula.
Really how did you get here then?
scripts.translation:
[米內]
拜託，去獵殺5只捕蟲堇。
說真的，那你又是怎麼到這裡來的？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Oh cruel world.
...
Way to go passing by.
What a fiasco this has turned out to be
scripts.translation:
[米內]
這殘酷的世界啊。
……
你路過得可真是時候。
事情怎麼會鬧成這副樣子。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Margaret gets everything she wants back at the camp.
Don't you worry, I'm going back soon.
scripts.translation:
[米內]
瑪格麗特在營地什麼都不缺。
放心，我很快就回去。

scripts.text: Margaret sent me.
scripts.translation: 瑪格麗特派我來的

scripts.text: Yeah I'm here...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我來了……

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Eh? Who!
I see. Is it that time already?
This has been difficult.
I'm in a crisis here!
scripts.translation:
[米內]
咦？誰啊！
我明白了，已經到約定的時間了嗎？
這事真難辦。
我現在可是焦頭爛額！

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Oh so you're not here by your own will eh?
So why even bother coming?
scripts.translation:
[米內]
哦，你不是自願來的啊？
那你何必跑這一趟？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
You didn't want to be here right?
Margaret sent you instead of someone else I bet.
Whatever, anyway I'm in a crisis here!
scripts.translation:
[米內]
你本來就不想來，對吧？
我猜是瑪格麗特派你來的，不是派了別人。算了，總之我現在焦頭爛額！

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Ok I don't want to admit it but you gotta help me out here.
scripts.translation:
[米內]
好吧，我不想承認，但你得幫我一把。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Ok just because I was complaining doesn't mean they have to send me here!
scripts.translation:
[米內]
我只是抱怨了幾句，他們也不至於把我派到這種地方來吧！

scripts.text:
[Mine]
I mean they've asked for too much of a simple person like myself.
scripts.translation:
[米內]
他們對我這種平凡人要求也太高了。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Ok here's the deal.
I'm supposed to hunt those Pinguiculas. Just 5 of 'em.
But you'll do that for me yeah?
scripts.translation:
[米內]
事情是這樣的。
我本來該去獵殺那些捕蟲堇，就5只而已。
不過你會替我去，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
I promise you I'll give you something good.
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[米內]
我保證會給你不錯的東西。
謝了。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
I mean, can you tell Margaret that it's all done?
scripts.translation:
[米內]
對了，你能告訴瑪格麗特事情已經辦妥了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mine]
Oh don't worry she won't mind. I'll just go back to doing what I was doing. Here's your reward.
scripts.translation:
[米內]
哦，放心，她不會介意的。我先回去繼續做原來的事。這是給你的報酬。

scripts.text:
[Mine]
You're not lying about being a real adventurer are you?
scripts.translation:
[米內]
你不是在冒充真正的冒險者吧？

scripts.text: - You have too many items in your inventory to continue -
scripts.translation: - 背包裡的物品太多，無法繼續 -

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm, are you a member of Eden Group?
You need to be one of our members to use my services.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯，你是樂園團的成員嗎？
只有本團成員才能使用我的服務。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
What's going on?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
怎麼了？

scripts.text: Strengthen Equipment
scripts.translation: 強化裝備

scripts.text: Personal Request
scripts.translation: 個人委託

scripts.text: Give me new equipment.
scripts.translation: 給我新裝備

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm equipment strengthening.
I don't exactly do that for just anyone.
The first step is at least a higher degree of training so have you done the Eden Group training yet?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯，裝備強化啊。
我可不會隨便替誰強化裝備。
至少要先完成進階訓練。你參加過樂園團的訓練了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Strengthen your equipment eh?
I'll strengthen the new Eden Group equipment for you by giving it a random stat boost.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
想強化裝備嗎？
我可以隨機提升屬性，幫你強化新的樂園團裝備。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I will strengthen your equipment after you've done a personal request of mine.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
完成我的個人委託後，我就幫你強化裝備。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Have you started the request of Instructor Ur?
I'm lending my services to those who are worthy.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你開始做指導員烏爾的委託了嗎？
我只願意為夠資格的人提供服務。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Glad you're here.
As a blacksmith I am in need of Iron materials constantly.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你來得正好。
我是鐵匠，平時總需要鐵礦材料。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Let me guess...
You've brought me the best quality materials.
Good.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
讓我猜猜……
你帶來的是品質最好的材料。
很好。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Now, that's it.
That's enough for today.
For now, ask me to strengthen your equipment and I'll do it for you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
好了，就到這裡吧。
今天先這樣。
現在你可以找我強化裝備，我會幫你處理。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Come back later.
You have to wait for some time first.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
過段時間再來。
你得先等一會兒。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Uh-huh...
What are we going to... oh don't worry.
Come to me later.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯……
我們要做什麼來著……哦，別擔心。
晚些時候再來找我。

scripts.text: [Thorn]
scripts.translation: [索恩]

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Okay, I'll give you equipment.
I'll give you good armor and equipment that you'll be proud of.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
好，我給你裝備。
我會給你一套優質的防具，讓你穿出去也覺得體面。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
You can strengthen the equipment that I gave you.
Weapons Expert BK is at Eden Group Headquarters and he can do that for you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
我給你的裝備可以強化。
樂園團總部有位武器專家BK，他能幫你強化。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Have you gotten your gear yet?
I can give you the gear but I can't strengthen it for you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你拿到裝備了嗎？
裝備我可以給你，但強化我幫不了。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I'm not permitted to do this by Instructor Ur.
Don't mess with me.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
指導員烏爾不准我這麼做。
別想糊弄我。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
You have not awakened yet.
First do the missions set forth by Instructor Ur and I'll help you strengthen your equipment.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你還沒有覺醒。
先完成指導員烏爾佈置的任務，我才會幫你強化裝備。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I won't help you unless you do that first!
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你不先完成那些任務，我就不會幫你！

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
So what equipment do you want to enhance?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
那麼，你想強化哪件裝備？

scripts.text: Eden Group Manteau II
scripts.translation: 樂園團斗篷Ⅱ

scripts.text: Eden Group Armor IV
scripts.translation: 樂園團制服Ⅳ

scripts.text: Eden Group Boots IV
scripts.translation: 樂園團短靴Ⅳ

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I just want to be sure that you're worthy of using my services.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
我只是想確認你夠資格使用我的服務。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Besides, you won't have the equipment that I can enhance until you do those missions.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
而且，完成那些任務之前，你還拿不到我能強化的裝備。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Of course there will be a reward eventually...
So...
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
當然，之後會有獎勵……
所以……

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Bring me some materials.
I need 20 Iron Ore, and 10 Iron.
It shouldn't be hard to get these can you bring them right away?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
給我帶些材料來。
我需要20個鐵礦石和10個鐵。
這些應該不難弄到，你能現在就帶來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Bring me some materials.
Bring 20 Used Iron Plate.
It shouldn't be hard to get these can you bring them right away?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
給我帶些材料來。
帶20箇舊鐵板來。
這些應該不難弄到，你能現在就帶來嗎？

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 沒問題。

scripts.text: I don't want to.
scripts.translation: 我不想去。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I appreciate it.
So take your time and I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
那就拜託你了。
不用著急，我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Eh...?
Guess you're too busy to help me.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯……？
看來你太忙了，沒空幫我。

scripts.text: [Thorn]
scripts.translation: [索恩]

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I can always use more Iron materials.
Instead of a normal reward I'll give you an advanced equipment.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
我總需要鐵製材料。
這次我會給你一件高階裝備作為報酬，不再給普通獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
If at any time you think you have equipment that you need to strengthen come by me again.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
以後要是有裝備需要強化，隨時再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
If you have one of these bring them to me.
Eden Group Manteau II, Eden Group Armor IV, Eden Group Boots IV.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
如果你有下面這些裝備，就帶來給我：
樂園團斗篷Ⅱ、樂園團制服Ⅳ、樂園團短靴Ⅳ。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
So now, ^4d4dffmake sure that you have enough free inventory space.^000000
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
那麼，^4d4dff先確認你的背包裡有足夠的空位。^000000

scripts.text: Let me organize my inventory.
scripts.translation: 我先整理一下背包

scripts.text: I have free space.
scripts.translation: 我有空位

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
You do that.
Free up your inventory so that you can get the weapons, boots, and all the other equipment.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
去整理吧。
騰出背包空間，才能領取武器、靴子和其他裝備。

scripts.text: [Thorn]
scripts.translation: [索恩]

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm, you are eligible to receive equipment.
Yeah I understand that.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯，你符合領取裝備的條件。
是的，我知道。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Here's your equipment.
I'll also give you the other gear that comes along with this set.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
這是給你的裝備。
這套裝備附帶的其他裝備我也一併給你。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm something went wrong though. I'm not sure what...
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯，好像出了點問題……我也不清楚原因。

scripts.text:
Here's your equipment.
I'll also give you the other gear that comes along with this set.
scripts.translation:
這是給你的裝備。
這套裝備附帶的其他裝備我也一併給你。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
So go to him and he can make your equipment stronger.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
去找他吧，他能幫你強化裝備。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Your armor can be strengthened by someone else.
I wish I could but I can't.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
你的防具可以找別人強化。
我也想幫你，可惜我做不到。

scripts.text: [Toren]
scripts.translation: [托倫]

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Eden Group {0}?
I understand.
Remember the stats that are enhanced will be random.
You sure you want me to enhance this?
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
樂園團{0}？
我明白了。
記住，強化屬性是隨機的。
你確定要我強化這件裝備嗎？

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm... Don't you have the {0}?
I don't think you have it with you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯……你沒有帶{0}嗎？
我看你身上並沒有這件裝備。

scripts.text: I changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 我改變主意了

scripts.text: Yes, enhance it.
scripts.translation: 好，幫我強化

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
You sure you don't want to enhance it?
It's your choice.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
確定不強化了嗎？
這是你的選擇。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
I understand.
Let's begin the enhancement.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
明白了。
那就開始強化吧。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Hmm... Don't you have the {0}?
I don't think you have it with you.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯……你沒有帶{0}嗎？
我看你身上並沒有這件裝備。

scripts.text:
[Thorn]
Ok, seems that the enhancement went well.
If you don't like the result then you can come back again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[索恩]
嗯，強化似乎很順利。
如果你不滿意結果，明天再來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[BK]
What's happening?
No way?!
scripts.translation:
[BK]
怎麼回事？
不會吧？！

scripts.text: Enhancing weapons.
scripts.translation: 強化武器

scripts.text: What?
scripts.translation: 什麼？

scripts.text:
[BK]
Yeah?
Are you asking me what I know?
scripts.translation:
[BK]
嗯？
你是想問我知道些什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[BK]
Ah, you're here to enhance your gear.
Okay, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[BK]
啊，你是來強化裝備的。
好，那我們開始吧？

scripts.text:
[BK]
Hmm, no.
I don't have permission from Instructor Ur.
You have to finish your training.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
嗯，不行。
我還沒得到指導員烏爾的許可。
你得先完成訓練。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Okay, what weapon do you want to enhance?
scripts.translation:
[BK]
好，你想強化哪把武器？

scripts.text:
[BK]
Hmm, I'm not sure you're ready.
All 3 steps of Instructor Ur's missions have to be completed first.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
嗯，我不確定你已經準備好了。
你得先完成指導員烏爾安排的全部三個階段。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Good. So you previously received an addition to Atk or Matk.
For this option you can choose from Brute, Plant, Fish, Dragon, Increased Heal.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
很好。你之前已經獲得了ATK或MATK加成。
這次可以選擇對野獸、植物、魚類或龍類造成額外傷害，也可以選擇提升治癒效果。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Okay, this is the last step.
I will make your weapon even more enhanced.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
好，這是最後一步。
我會進一步強化你的武器。

scripts.text:
[BK]
How do you like your enhanced weapon?
Hopefully it has helped you.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
強化後的武器用起來怎麼樣？
希望它能幫上你的忙。

scripts.text:
[BK]
You have to have the equipment first in order for me to do anything.
Didn't you get anything from Thorn yet?
scripts.translation:
[BK]
你得先拿到裝備，我才能幫你處理。
你還沒從索恩那裡領到裝備嗎？

scripts.text:
[BK]
Instructor Ur has a lot of training missions doesn't he?
There's only one more stage.
Reach the final stage of training.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
指導員烏爾安排了不少訓練任務吧？
現在只剩最後一個階段了。
完成最終階段的訓練吧。

scripts.text: [BK]
scripts.translation: [BK]

scripts.text:
[BK]
Once you do that I can help you.
Until then I won't talk to you.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
完成之後我就能幫你。
在此之前，我不會跟你談。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Ok for the first reinforcement.
ATK + 3% or MATK + 3%?
I'll give you the option to grant this effect on the selected gear.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
第一次強化，你想要ATK + 3%還是MATK + 3%？
選擇後，我就把效果附加到你指定的裝備上。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Are you kidding me?
You don't seem to have that weapon in your possession.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
你在開玩笑嗎？
你身上似乎沒有那把武器。

scripts.text:
[BK]
You can't change your mind after so choose wisely.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
選好之後就不能反悔，慎重選擇。

scripts.text: ATK +3%
scripts.translation: ATK +3%

scripts.text: MATK +3%

scripts.text:

Isn't it magnificent?
I know, I know, I'm pretty amazing!
scripts.translation:
[BK]
這效果很棒吧？我知道，我知道，我確實很厲害！

scripts.text:
[BK]
You get what I'm saying?
Finish the third mission from Instructor Ur.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
明白我的意思了嗎？
去完成指導員烏爾的第三個任務吧。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Once you've chosen you can't change your mind again.
But your weapon will increase damage to the type of enhancement you pick.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
選定之後就不能反悔。
不過，你的武器會對你所選型別的魔物造成更多傷害。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Basically I will add a random monster card with the property type that you choose.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[BK]
簡單來說，我會給武器隨機附加一張符合你所選型別的魔物卡片。
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[BK]
Good. Your weapon will now increase Heal effectiveness.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
很好，你的武器現在能提升治癒效果了。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Good. Your weapon will increase attacks to {0} type monsters.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
很好，你的武器現在會對{0}型魔物造成更多傷害。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Sorry, but it doesn't seem like you have a weapon that can be enhanced.
How did this happen?
scripts.translation:
[BK]
抱歉，你似乎沒有可供強化的武器。
這是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[BK]
Isn't it magnificent?
I know, I know, I'm pretty amazing!
scripts.translation:
[BK]
這效果很棒吧？我知道，我知道，我確實很厲害！

scripts.text:
[BK]
The card added from the previous step will be doubled.
And if you have a healing weapon it will increase it's healing efficiency.
You understand?
scripts.translation:
[BK]
上一步附加的卡片效果會翻倍。
如果你拿的是治癒系武器，治癒效果也會提升。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[BK]
Ok what weapon did you have now?
scripts.translation:
[BK]
好了，你現在拿著哪把武器？

scripts.text:
[BK]
Doubling the strength of your bonus stat.
scripts.translation:
[BK]
讓你的額外屬性效果翻倍。

scripts.text:
[BK]
Hey, you think I'm joking?
Do you have the weapons or not?
scripts.translation:
[BK]
喂，你以為我在開玩笑嗎？
到底有沒有武器？

scripts.text:
[BK]
Isn't it magnificent?
I know, I know, I'm pretty amazing!
scripts.translation:
[BK]
這效果很棒吧？我知道，我知道，我確實很厲害！

scripts.text:
[BK]
I've given you the peak of your weapon's efficiency.
Weapons aren't the only things that need strength, though, don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[BK]
我已經把你的武器強化到效能極限了。
不過，需要變強的可不只有武器，你說對吧？

scripts.text:
[BK]
Come on admit it.
Thorn gave inspiration and I intend on providing strong equipment, that's how to live life.
Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[BK]
快承認吧。
索恩負責提供靈感，我負責打造強力裝備，這樣活著才有意思。
哈哈哈哈！
